sourceMapPrerequisite: Requires Node.js and npm on your PATH in your application’s repository. Spool’s installer keeps its runtime private; it does not provide npm on your shell’s PATH. For browser capture without npm, use the browser helper on Capture. Follow the Node.js prerequisite setup steps, then return here. For maps built on another computer or CI, use the picker on Releases with the matching release, build and debug ID; the deployed bundle must be the same stamped build.
